0022600095.text: The Pacers, 1-0 and 2nd in the Central, host the 0-1 Dallas Mavericks, who are 14th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 1 game back, in Indiana's second game of the season. Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pacers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 134-130 defeat in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
